description: Controllers monitor pressures, flows, and alarms and operate remote valves and the compressor station through SCADA, 24x7
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Public safety (overpressure or undetected rupture); firm deliveries to 2 LDCs serving about 140,000 customers and a power plant; manual operation with field staff can hold the line safely for about one 8-hour shift before fatigue and loss of line-pack visibility force pressure reduction
manual_workaround: Fail over to the backup control room (target 1 h); otherwise station field technicians at the compressor station, receipt interconnect, and the 4 largest M&R stations and operate by radio and phone under the manual operation plan (192.631(c)(3))
dependent_third_parties: Telecom carrier (cellular sites); SCADA integrator; upstream interstate pipeline
dependent_people_or_facilities: Gas controllers; SCADA Engineer; field technicians; Gas Control Center and Compressor Station 1

description: Run the 2 compressor units to hold delivery pressures during peak demand
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without compression, delivery pressure at the south end drops below contract minimums on high-demand days; units can run locally from the station control panel
manual_workaround: Local operation from the station control panel by compressor station technicians

business_process: Emergency response and public safety communication
description: Receive and classify emergency notices, dispatch field crews, notify 9-1-1 centers and officials, and make incident notices (192.615; 49 CFR Part 191)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Emergency response cannot pause: 49 CFR 191.5 sets a 1-hour notice clock after confirmed discovery of an incident; 192.615 requires communication with public safety answering points
manual_workaround: Printed emergency contact lists at each site; personal cell phones; radio
dependent_third_parties: Public safety answering points; county emergency managers; National Response Center; FPSC
dependent_people_or_facilities: Pipeline Safety and Compliance Manager; on-call supervisor

description: Receive daily customer nominations, confirm with the upstream interstate pipeline, and balance receipts and deliveries
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Nomination deadlines each gas day; imbalance charges from the upstream pipeline; customers need confirmed volumes for the next gas day
manual_workaround: Phone and email nominations to a spreadsheet; confirm by phone with the upstream pipeline scheduler
dependent_third_parties: Nominations portal vendor; upstream interstate pipeline

business_process: Gas measurement and custody transfer data
description: Collect hourly and daily volumes and gas quality from flow computers and chromatographs; validate for billing and balancing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Flow computers keep about 35 days of data locally, so field data is not lost; the measurement application in the cloud is needed to validate and publish volumes
manual_workaround: Download flow computer archives on site with a laptop; estimate from SCADA historian totals
dependent_systems: SYS-03; SYS-01 historian; SYS-09 measurement application

description: Anomaly model scores historian data and alerts controllers to possible leaks (P10)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Advisory only; the SCADA pressure and flow alarms, patrols (192.705), and leakage surveys (192.706) remain the required methods; loss reduces early warning
manual_workaround: Controllers rely on SCADA rate-of-change alarms and line-pack trending
dependent_systems: SYS-09 analytics workload; SYS-05 historian replica

description: Monthly transportation invoices, imbalance statements, and revenue accounting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly billing cycle; about $2.1 million billed per month; invoices can be issued late without service impact. A billing outage alone does not justify shutting the pipeline
manual_workaround: Issue estimated invoices from the prior month and true up later

business_process: Field operations and maintenance, integrity, and compliance records
description: Work orders, patrols, leakage surveys, operator qualification records, GIS maps
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Compliance records must be available for FPSC inspection; field crews need maps for emergency response (printed maps kept in trucks)
manual_workaround: Printed maps and paper work orders
dependent_people_or_facilities: Field technicians; Pipeline Safety and Compliance Manager

description: Payroll, onboarding and terminations, accounts payable
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; missing payroll has legal and retention impact
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider
